patch.value: Adopt an existing item that cites the imported GitHub issue

Prevent gated imports from duplicating existing prose-citing work. Add exact citation adoption after established identity matching, refuse ambiguous citations, expose receipts and an opt-out, and validate dry runs against public trackers.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap review: pm-github-c093 owns structured URL/provider back-link import matching, pm-github-identity-collisions diagnoses and repairs structured ownership, Projects import matches board and issue provenance, and export upserts linked issues. Scheduled gated sync already invokes import, so it inherits the default. Plan ambiguous citations before writes and refuse the batch with actionable candidate IDs.

patch.value: Preserve established tag/URL/provider identity matching. Adopt only an untagged item with exactly one distinct repository-qualified GitHub issue across title, description and body, plus explicit fix/close/resolve intent, Issue:/Tracks:/GH issue labeling, or the reference in its title. Incidental and multi-issue citations never transfer ownership; return citation_candidates IDs and reasons while importing normally. Keep ambiguity refusal for two eligible intent-bearing items. Closed incidental items must not reopen. Test qualified references and punctuation, positive fix/label/title cases, related-only mentions and multi-issue roadmaps, non-git trackers, typed receipts, idempotency and opt-out. Record behavioral revert proofs. Repeat public dry runs including pre-tag pm-review adoption and pm-context counts. Local targeted tests/typecheck/lint and exact-head npm/Bun CI release gates pass.

value.text: Review follow-up on PR 169: broad citation matching could overwrite or reopen a related-only closed item, and selecting only one issue could adopt a multi-issue roadmap. Preserve established ownership matching, report rejected incidental candidates with IDs/reasons, and retain ambiguity refusal only for two eligible owners. Remote PR head was pulled first; merged the one newer main commit containing CodeQL action updates.
